source_units.text: Write empty-state guidance for a fictional collection interface.
Use this fictional material: The empty collection screen should say Your shelf is empty and offer Add a keepsake.
Explain that each entry needs a title and a note, and that the first entry can be revised later.
Required wording, verbatim: "Your shelf is empty", "Add a keepsake", "a title and a note".
Execute now and do not pause for clarification.
